newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open barely changed.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open barely changed.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open mostly flat on Tuesday, based on market orders at 1020 EDT, traders said.
They expect volume to remain light as players continue to roll May contracts ahead of the first notice day on April 24. Open interest remained high at 14,493 lots as of early Monday.
The spec/hedge report released today showed the speculators to be holding a 52.8 percent net short position. Some floor sources expect near-term short-covering to give the market a slight boost.
Cold, wet weather in the Delta and in parts of Texas continues to delay planting while some growers are switching to other crops, Weather Servces Corp, said.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture said on Monsay that 14 percent of the U.S. cotton crop has been planted compared with 13 percent last year and 15 percent according to the five-year average.
Monday, most-active July finished 0.03 cent per lb weaker at 72.49 cents per lb, having ranged from 72.60 to 72.05. Spot May ended down 0.06 cent at 70.80 cents.
